name: vcf-automation-9.1-catalog-deployment
sourceStatement: This contract was transcribed by hand from the VCF Automation xAPIs reference pages published at developer.broadcom.com. It is NOT derived from a published specification. VCF Automation has no OpenAPI document in the vmware/vcf-api-specs repository, and the VCF PowerCLI SDK ships no generated VMware.Sdk.Vcf module for it, so there is no machine-readable artefact to generate this from. Every operation, path, property name, type and description below was read off a reference page; docs/official_sources.json records which page, which operation it documents, and the date it was read. Where the reference pages are silent or self-contradictory, this contract says so in a 'note' field and states the behaviour the loopback stand-in enforces. Treat the recorded pages as the upstream authority and this file as authoritative for the stand-in.

server.description: Root URL of the VCF Automation appliance. The reference pages render it as https://{api_host}. Operation paths below are appended to it unchanged; there is no additional base path.

bearerAuth.name: Authorization
bearerAuth.description: Header value is the tokenType and the token returned by retrieveAuthToken, joined by a single space, e.g. 'Bearer eyJ...'. The reference pages name this scheme 'bearerAuth'.

retrieveAuthToken.note: The reference page annotates this operation with the Authorization security scheme, which cannot be right for the call that mints the token. It is sent without an Authorization header; the stand-in rejects one that carries it.

queryParameters.name: page
queryParameters.description: Zero-based page index (0..N)

queryParameters.name: size
queryParameters.description: The size of the page to be returned

queryParameters.name: sort
queryParameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc)

queryParameters.name: ids
queryParameters.description: A comma-separated list. Only deployments with these IDs will be included in the results

queryParameters.name: search
queryParameters.description: Given string should either be part of a searchable field in a deployment or one of deployment's resources

queryParameters.name: name
queryParameters.description: Results must have exactly this name

queryParameters.name: status
queryParameters.description: A comma-separated list. Results must be associated with one of these statuses

queryParameters.name: projects
queryParameters.description: A comma-separated list. Results must be associated with one of these project IDs

queryParameters.name: resourceTypes
queryParameters.description: A comma-separated list. Results must be associated with one of these resourceType Names

queryParameters.name: cloudAccounts
queryParameters.description: A comma-separated list. Results must be associated with one of these cloud accounts

queryParameters.name: cloudTypes
queryParameters.description: A comma-separated list. Results must be associated with one of these endpoint Types

queryParameters.name: requestedBy
queryParameters.description: A comma-separated list. Results must be associated with one of these requesters

queryParameters.name: ownedBy
queryParameters.description: A comma-separated list. Results must be associated with one of these owners

queryParameters.name: tags
queryParameters.description: A comma-separated list. Results must be associated with one of these tags

queryParameters.name: createdAt
queryParameters.description: Comma-separated start and end dates where start date or end date is optional

queryParameters.name: expiresAt
queryParameters.description: Comma-separated start and end dates where start date or end date is optional

queryParameters.name: lastUpdatedAt
queryParameters.description: Comma-separated start and end dates where start date or end date is optional

queryParameters.name: expandResources
queryParameters.description: The 'resources' field of each resulting deployment will be retrieved

queryParameters.name: expandLastRequest
queryParameters.description: Expands deployment last request

queryParameters.name: expandProject
queryParameters.description: The 'project' field of each resulting deployment will be retrieved

queryParameters.name: expand
queryParameters.description: The expanded details of the requested comma separated objects

queryParameters.name: lastRequestStatus
queryParameters.description: A comma-separated list of last request statuses

queryParameters.name: deleted
queryParameters.description: Retrieves only soft-deleted deployments that have not yet been completely deleted

queryParameters.name: $top
queryParameters.description: Number of records you want

queryParameters.name: $skip
queryParameters.description: Number of records you want to skip

queryParameters.name: $orderby
queryParameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property (asc|desc)

queryParameters.name: $filter
queryParameters.description: A subset of records that satisfy the given predicate expression

200.note: The reference page documents the 200 body as an array even for a single-instance request; one element per requested instance.

idempotency.note: The reference page documents no idempotency key, no If-Match/If-None-Match precondition and no de-duplication window for this operation. Every accepted call allocates a new deployment, so a resend that the caller believes failed can leave two deployments behind. Callers that need retry safety have to build it from getDeployments; nothing in the wire contract provides it.

refreshToken.description: Refresh token obtained from the UI

CatalogItemRequest.note: Every property is optional in the reference page. The page documents no null semantics, so a property that is present with a null value is not the same thing as a property that is absent; see the deploymentName and bulkRequestCount descriptions.

bulkRequestCount.description: Deployment request count; defaults to 1 if not specified.

projectId.description: Project to be used for the request

version.description: Version of the catalog item. e.g. v2.0

DeploymentRequest.description: The blueprint service's response to a deployment request

Deployment.note: Transcribed from the Get Deployment By Id reference page. Only the properties the stand-in populates are listed; the page documents more (description, blueprintId, blueprintVersion, orgId, createdBy, lastUpdatedAt, lastUpdatedBy, leaseExpireAt, leaseGracePeriodDays, ownerType, inputs, outputs, resources, expense, lastRequest).

PageOfDeployments.note: Spring-style page envelope, transcribed from the Get Deployments reference page.

excludedOperations.reason: Day-2 action on an existing deployment. Read while deriving this contract and deliberately left off it: provisioning a new deployment never needs it. The stand-in answers 404 for it, as it does for anything else not named above.
Read for the Deployment schema only. getDeployments already returns whole Deployment objects, so fetching one by id after a lookup would be a redundant round trip. The stand-in answers 404 for it.
